spec.t_means: day 18 at t = 0, day 23 at t = 1; day(t) = 18 + 5t
spec.handover: at t = 1 this model's tube IS cardiac-looping's tube at ITS t = 0 — measured by continuity()

tests.says: fusion runs CRANIAL to CAUDAL and never runs backwards
tests.must: the fusion front is 1 at t = 0, 0 at t = 1, and non-increasing at every step between

tests.says: the front is SOLVED from contact, not scheduled
tests.must: at the front the two tubes touch to within 1e-3 of their own radius

tests.says: mid-zip the picture shows BOTH states at once — one tube cranially, two caudally
tests.must: at t = 0.76, the t the zip view is drawn at: the tube is single over at least 40% of its length, and at the venous end the two tubes' surfaces are at least 35% of a diameter apart

tests.says: the dates are a RESULT of the horseshoe, and they land where the narration says
tests.must: fusion begins after day 20.5 and is complete between day 21.5 and day 22.5

tests.says: the head fold INVERTS the order — the septum transversum crosses the heart
tests.must: at day 18 the septum transversum is cranial to the heart, at day 23 caudal, each by at least 35% of their mean cranio-caudal extent

tests.says: and the buccopharyngeal membrane crosses it the other way
tests.must: at day 18 the heart lies cranial to the membrane, at day 23 caudal, by the same floor

tests.says: two tubes at day 18, ONE tube straddling the median plane at day 23
tests.must: at t = 0 the two tubes are disjoint in x by at least 35% of their mean width; at t = 1 the tube puts at least 45% of its width on each side of x = 0 and is centred within 3%

tests.says: three coats, in order, each of them legible
tests.must: myocardium, jelly and endocardium each occupy at least 18% of the wall depth at the ventricle body at day 23, and no two of them share a surface

tests.says: the segment boundaries sit at the named WAISTS
tests.must: each of the four internal boundaries is within 0.015 of a local minimum of the day-23 calibre

tests.says: the dorsal mesocardium is intact while the tube is still fusing and broken by day 23
tests.must: the central gap is zero before fusion completes and 0.055 at day 23 — cardiac-looping's own day-23 gap

tests.says: the tube outgrows the cavity that holds it
tests.must: the clearance around the tube falls from at least 30% at day 18 to at most 14% at day 23, and never rises once fusion is complete. It DOES rise once, by about 0.08, at the moment fusion completes: two tubes side by side are wider than the one tube they become

tests.says: cardia bifida is an ARREST of this mechanism, not a different drawing
tests.must: with the lateral folds arrested the front never leaves the cranial end and the two tubes stay disjoint by at least 35% of their mean width at day 23
